title: Batch Picking Workflow
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P2 Supporting Domains

key_findings.model: stock.picking.batch with state=[draft,in_progress,done,cancel] computed from picking_ids.state
key_findings.lifecycle: draft → action_confirm (in_progress) → action_done (delegates to button_validate on pickings) → done (auto-computed when all pickings done/cancel)
key_findings.batch_validation: action_done calls pickings.with_context(skip_sanity_check=True).button_validate(); no separate batch _action_done; individual picking validate is the mechanism
key_findings.backorder_handling: backorders are collected in button_validate override and submitted to _find_auto_batch for re-batching; picking removed from batch if validated independently with remaining incomplete siblings
key_findings.wave_picking: is_wave Boolean on stock.picking.batch; _add_to_wave splits pickings by move lines; _auto_wave runs after stock reservation
key_findings.auto_batch: _find_auto_batch triggered on action_confirm and after stock assignment; respects batch_max_lines/batch_max_pickings; batch_auto_confirm=True by default
key_findings.cross_module: module depends only on stock; warehouse defaults auto_batch=True+batch_group_by_partner=True for incoming/outgoing; no delivery module cross-dependency in Community
key_findings.security: stock.group_stock_user has full CRUD on stock.picking.batch; multi-company ir.rule restricts to allowed companies
